senses.gloss:
एष् 1. एष् (आ-इष्), cl. 6. P. एच्छति, ऐषि-
तुम् or -ष्टुम्, to wish, desire.

एष् 2. एष् (आ-ईष्), cl. 1. P. A., Ved. एषति,
-ते, एषितुम्, to hasten near to or towards; to fly at;
to attack any one; to endeavour to reach or gain; to
desire; to request.

एष् 3. एष्, cl. 1. P. A. एषति, -ते, एषाञ्-
चकार, एषाञ्-चक्रे, एषितुम्, to creep,
glide; to go or approach: Caus. एषयति, -यितुम्,
to probe.
